title: Sara Duterte’s call for admin to ‘start working, stop politicking’ is ‘laughable’ — Palace
summary: Vice President Sara Duterte’s call for the Marcos administration to “stop politicking and start working” is “laughable,” Malacañang said on Wednesday.
